name: Kemonomichi -Go-
source:
This is the 5th volume of the "Kemonomichi" series!
The battle diary of a magic thunder soldier and blonde archer. 

Introducing a possible "bad ending" for the first time! 
Will you emerge in righteous victory, or humiliated and wronged? 
What fate will you choose for these assault-prone girls!? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE071294.html]DLsite English[/url]]
